title: I shipped a synthwave inspired racing game
author: alphaomega800
selftext:
Afterglow is a neon arcade racer, drift mechanics, fill a boost meter, knock rivals into walls, and race a boss at the end of each world which becomes slightly more challenging.

I used Claude Code for this. I do have prior coding and visual design knowledge. 

Play (desktop, no install): https://afterglow86.com

Everything unlocked (all worlds, stages and cars, skip the campaign):   
https://afterglow86.com/?unlockall

Controls: WASD or arrows, Space to drift, Shift to boost.

Things I already know about:

	•	Sound needs reworking from the ground up  
	•	Mobile is iffy, try it tell me if it sucks  
	•	A few minor graphics glitches  
	•	No gamepad yet

What I'd like to know:

Does the driving feel good? Too easy, too slippery, too stiff?If you know about mobile racing game mechanics any pointers?  
Anything I should know? Constructive criticism is always welcome.

comments.author: Raqnarock
comments.body:
Hey I did some driving (on PC) and some things I have noticed:

- It is quite easy to take out other drivers, when playing on medium I can hit two of them at the start and they flip around and I can take 1st place quite easily. 

- Driving feels a bit slidey (disconnected) but maybe thats because I do not hear any slipping or skid sounds since as you say sound needs rework. Seeing some skidmarks on the road as you floor it or go fast in the corners might help with the feeling.

- Music gets louder if you release gas/lower speed but when you accelerate it gets more quiet, maybe that should be reversed. 

- After finishing a single race I would expect to return to the main menu but I end up at the track selection. This might be a matter of personal preference but wanted to mention it.

- The camera has a tendency to follow the track instead of the car and I think that feels weird when you are driving in 3rd person. I got used to it a bit after two races but it still looks a bit weird to me.

- Maybe a cockpit/1st person view can be added.

Stylistically its quite cool so far but I do feel that I have seen racing games like this before but that might also be video clips I have seen that have a 80s/vaporwave style.

replies.author: alphaomega800
replies.body: Super constructive I appreciate this. Looking into these issues today!

replies.author: Raqnarock
replies.body:
Sure hope it helps! I have heard that getting consistency is harder when you make multiple prompts but I will keep checking the main section to see if there is any proof of that. (including projects from other people)

Before I forget: I was curious on the selection of cars. Did you give it specific instructions on making each type of car including pictures (like the Countach, F40 etc. or did you state something like "super cars from the 1980s")
